name: Pipedream
description: Pipedream is a developer-focused integration and automation platform for building workflows that connect APIs, AI, and databases with code-level control when needed.
best_for: Developers who want visual workflow building with the option to drop into custom code, for connecting APIs and building AI agents.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: 100 credits/day (a daily cap, not a monthly pool), max 3 connected accounts, community support only. Pipedream Connect only usable in development mode.

tiers.name: Basic
tiers.notes: Annual-billing rate; 2,000 credits/month included. The no-commitment monthly rate is higher.

tiers.name: Connect
tiers.notes: Annual-billing rate; 10,000 credits/month, for teams embedding Pipedream Connect in their own product.

tiers.name: Business/Enterprise
tiers.notes: Contact sales; HIPAA/SOC2/GDPR compliance, dedicated Success Engineer, 99.95% SLA.

cons: Free tier credits are capped at 100/day rather than a monthly pool, with a hard limit of 3 connected accounts, and Pipedream Connect only works in development mode below paid tiers.

Billing is metered by compute, not by task -- one credit equals 30 seconds at 256MB RAM, so increasing a workflow's memory allocation increases credit burn proportionally rather than cost simply scaling with run volume.

Workday signed a definitive agreement to acquire Pipedream (announced November 2025); public self-serve pricing is unchanged today, but the platform's independent roadmap and pricing are now subject to a large enterprise acquirer's plans.
features: Visual workflow builder with time- and event-based triggers
Code steps for custom Node.js, Python, Go, or Bash logic within a workflow
Pipedream Connect SDK for embedding integrations into your own product
AI agent builder for prompting, running, and deploying agents
Built-in data stores and queues for stateful workflows
MCP servers exposing 3,000+ APIs to AI assistants

alternatives.name: n8n
alternatives.description: A source-available workflow automation tool combining visual building with custom code for technical teams.
alternatives.best_for: Technical teams that want self-hostable, code-extensible automation

alternatives.name: Zapier
alternatives.description: A no-code automation platform that connects thousands of web apps through simple trigger-and-action workflows.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want fast, no-code automations between cloud apps

alternatives.name: Make
alternatives.description: A visual automation platform for building multi-step workflows between apps with a drag-and-drop scenario builder.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want visual, complex multi-step automations

alternatives.name: Zoho Flow
alternatives.description: An AI-powered integration platform that connects cloud and on-premises apps and automates workflows across departments.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses already using Zoho's app ecosystem who want no-code workflow automation across 1,000+ apps
